title: snapjudge policy-v1
description: A GatePolicy (redesign §4, §8, §9): gate thresholds bound to one definition id and exact `definition_revision`, a pinned resolved provider model (aliases `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` rejected) and evidence. Strict: no unknown fields except inside `metrics`, no explicit nulls. `policy_revision` is SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the policy without `policy_revision`; it is always computed, and a stated value must equal it. snapjudge additionally enforces: measured evidence has `metrics.wilson_lower >= target` and `metrics.accepted >= min_accepted`; `metrics.accepted <= metrics.n`; `metrics.target`, when present, equals `target`; integers anywhere inside `metrics` have magnitude at most 2^53 - 1; every threshold key names an output of the bound definition (`output.label` for MultiLabel labels) and every output and every MultiLabel label, required or not, has a threshold.

metrics.description: Extensible: further keys are kept and hashed.
